summary.headline: Google I/O pushes agents and models forward; Descendants climbs
summary.body: Google I/O dominated. Google launched Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini Omni, which lifts Capability Velocity, and introduced Gemini Spark, an always-on agent that can act across Gmail and even buy things for users within limits. That lifts AI Autonomy, the factor behind endings where AI runs on its own: Descendants, Zookeeper and Benevolent Dictator all rose. Google and Samsung also confirmed Gemini-powered smart glasses for this fall, a small step for Human-AI Merging that helps Descendants. On the safety side, OpenAI, Kakao and ElevenLabs adopted Google's SynthID watermark, a modest boost to Alignment & Control that helps Protector God. KPMG's rollout of Claude to 276,000 staff added to Power Concentration. Gatekeeper and Egalitarian Utopia swapped places. Horizon Balance edged up 0.03 to 1.6.
summary.movers_note: Descendants +1.1, led by the Gemini Spark agent launch (+0.48), Gemini 3.5 Flash/Omni (+0.33) and the Android XR glasses (+0.19); Zookeeper +0.8, mostly from Gemini Spark (+0.48); Protector God +0.8 from the agent launch and SynthID adoption (+0.10).

Samsung's Gemini-powered Android XR glasses ship this fall

events.title: Google I/O: Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini Omni launched
events.summary: Google made Gemini 3.5 Flash the default model across Gemini and Search, launched Gemini Omni (any-input-to-video multimodal model) and said Gemini 3.5 Pro is due in June. Gemini app passed 900M monthly users.
events.reason: New frontier-lab model generation with notable gains; mostly Google's own benchmark claims.

events.title: Google launches Gemini Spark 24/7 agent and agent payments protocol
events.summary: Google introduced Gemini Spark, a background agent running on cloud VMs that acts across Gmail/Workspace, plus Managed Agents API and an agent payments protocol letting agents buy on users' behalf within limits.
events.reason: Agents given standing access and spending authority at consumer scale.

events.title: Google unveils TPU 8t/8i, its first dual-chip TPU generation
events.summary: Google announced TPU 8t for training (about 3x raw compute of predecessor) and 8i for inference.

events.title: Google, Samsung confirm Android XR AI glasses for fall 2026
events.summary: Google said Gemini-powered Android XR glasses from Samsung with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker frames will ship this fall in audio and display versions.
events.reason: Always-on AI wearables move human-AI integration closer to the body; consumer device announcement.

events.title: SynthID watermark adopted by OpenAI, Kakao and ElevenLabs
events.summary: Google said SynthID has watermarked over 100 billion files and detection is coming to Search and Chrome, with OpenAI, Kakao and ElevenLabs adopting it.
events.reason: Cross-company provenance standard; modest control/trust improvement.

events.title: KPMG deploys Claude to 276,000 staff in 138 countries
events.summary: KPMG and Anthropic announced a global alliance and 'Digital Gateway Powered by Claude' covering KPMG's whole workforce.
events.reason: Enterprise lock-in for one frontier lab; incremental.
